nom: Sun Bum Daily Glow Tinted Moisturizer SPF 30

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report the product does not leave a greasy or oil-slick feeling by afternoon and one notes zero breakouts.
segments.dry: A reviewer with dry skin describes the formula as perfectly balanced, not runny nor thick, and calls it her holy grail base.
segments.combination: A combination/oily reviewer says it wears well with or without makeup and does not irritate or break her out.
segments.sensitive: A self-described very fair-skinned reviewer who burns easily reports it works well for her.
segments.mature: An older reviewer with fine lines finds it gives a balanced, subtle glow without looking fake or shimmery, though she had not yet tested a full day in the sun.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports the glow looks natural on fine lines rather than exaggerating them.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the product as moisturizing, soft, and hydrated-feeling; no reports of dryness or tightness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report it blurs redness and lets them skip concealer; no dissent noted.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says it covers old sun spots and hyperpigmentation enough to skip a skin tint.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with oily or acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts and even coverage of existing breakouts; however one reviewer reports the worst acne of her life after a formula change, and another says she will monitor for breakouts over time.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple oily-skin reviewers report the product does not feel greasy and controls shine through the day; one reviewer found the reformulated version sits heavier than the old one.

aspects.libelle: White cast on darker skin tones
Reformulation seen as worse by some

extraits.texte: They changed packaging and I thin formula too, I was using for almost 2 year the old glow30 and when I buy thin new one…. Let me tell you I had the worst acne in couple days… stay away from this product. And for Sunbum: dont change your products when you see people are really buying and enjoys them.

I am a skincare guru and I love me some sunscreen I also have dry skin and prefer a glowy base. I have so many products and I forgot I had bought this one before.. I saw it in my collection and tried it.. and WOW !!! I AM IN. LOVE IM OBSESSED!!! I love the formula so much! The consistency is perfect it's not runny but it's not to thick it's perfect I love the color it's like a champagne that is flattering on everyone and most of all I'm obsessed with the packaging! I love anything with a pump this product is literally perfection from the formula to the packaging please never stop making this! I'm begging you sun bum! I love this brand so much esp their leave in conditioner but this product takes the cake!!! My new holy grail sunscreen/ makeup primer

I usually dont wear sunscreen on my face because I can never find one that fits my skin needs due to having oily skin that breaks out so easily, but this sunscreen is actually amazing! It doesn't feel heavy on my skin and does not leave a white cast either which is important since I do have brown skin. I was a little worried since it said it was tinted and didn't have a color option but the color actually blends really nicely! I would highly recommend this sunscreen and the smell is lovely, not too strong. I'm glad I finally found a sunscreen that works for me!!

I was a little nervous because I liked the older version of this that I had, and I wasn't sure how much had changed besides the packaging. Overall, great improvement with the pump. This sunscreen is pretty thin and my older bottles used to be a mess. I've been outside all day and have applied this three times… it feels like there is nothing on my skin! I have rosace, and the tinted glow helps blur my redness a lot!
Love this. Wears beautifully with or without makeup. Doesn't irritate or break me out. I have combo/more oiky skin.

I know some people have complained about how thin or watery this product is, but it seems perfect for me. As an older woman with some "life lines", I was worried that it might stand out and make me look fake but this ads a very balanced and subtle glow without a shimmer. I quite like how it looks and feels. I haven't given it the full test of a day in the sun, but I'm impressed for an everyday sunscreen.

This is my holy grail sunscreeen. The glow looks natural-not glittery at all. And it evens out my hyperpigmentation enough that I feel fine skipping my skin tint/concealer for natural look days. It is runny, and a little messy, but the glow and light coverage lasts all day, so it's worth it for me.
